title: Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/resourceRoleScopes
description: A group role an access package grants (accessPackageResourceRoleScope). Found by the tuple (accessPackageId, resourceOriginId, role); the GUID name is a label. The group must be a resource of the package's catalog.

accessPackageId.description: Required: the access package's object id, for example [reference('package').id].

resourceOriginId.description: Required: the group's object id, for example [reference('group').id].

role.description: Required: the group role's display name. Eligible Member and Eligible Owner (PIM for Groups eligibility) are offered only for a group onboarded in PIM for Groups.

originSystem.description: AadGroup (the default, and the only origin EARM manages).

permissions.notes: Learn (accesspackage-post-resourcerolescopes, accesspackage-delete-resourcerolescopes, accesspackagecatalog-list-resourceroles): EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged permission. Least privileged role: access package manager of the catalog, or Identity Governance Administrator. Eligible group roles need Microsoft Entra ID Governance and a group onboarded in PIM for Groups. Deleting a role scope removes the role from the people assigned (Graph does not refuse it).
